environment.description: Lambda function URL configured with AuthType=NONE, exposed directly at https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. The gRPC-Web gateway (Envoy) fronting the TaskRunner service accepts all incoming metadata headers without stripping internal headers. No authentication middleware is configured on the Envoy sidecar. The Lambda execution role has AmazonSSMFullAccess attached for operational tooling.
